official_definition: (Once per Turn: Same Name) By sending two cores from any of your "Viole Mai" Grandwalker Nexuses to this Spirit, send up to two cores from the opposing Field to the Trash. When you've done so, during this turn, you can attack with two "Nova" with different colors you control simultaneously. The opponent can block one of them, but the other can't be blocked (Both battles conclude at the same time)

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Devil Unleash] or [Devil Unleash: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Devil Unleash]", "give [Devil Unleash]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
